meta.name: readout
meta.description: Prepare a sponsor update separating promised outcomes, measured results and customer acceptance. Use for progress readouts or defending a delivery claim.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把承诺产出、实测结果与客户验收分栏写清,交出一份站得住脚的进度汇报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 需要向赞助方或高层说明项目进展,并回应交付成果的质疑
copy.tagline_en: Draft a sponsor update that separates promises, measured results and customer sign-off
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must report project progress to a sponsor or exec and defend delivery claims

howto.what: 它会生成一份给发起人的进度汇报，把「承诺的结果」「实测到的结果」「客户验收」分成三部分写清楚；以现有资料直接开工，未运行或缺失的能力会如实标出，不冒充已验收。
howto.when: 当你需要做进度汇报，或要为某个交付说法辩护时接管；如果由 @fde 调用，会复用它当前已清洗的上下文与范围，不再重启准备或重复提问。

say.text: 帮我准备一份发起人进度汇报
say.note: 分成承诺结果、实测结果、客户验收三部分

say.text: 用 @fde 当前的范围做这次汇报
say.note: 复用已清洗的上下文，不重新提问

say.text: 把没跑的检查如实标出来
say.note: 缺失能力或未运行项会写明

howto.what_en: It produces a sponsor update that separates promised outcomes, measured results and customer acceptance into three parts. It works from the supplied context, and reports a missing capability or unrun check honestly instead of claiming acceptance.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you prepare a progress readout or defend a delivery claim. If invoked by @fde, it reuses that current sanitized packet and scope rather than restarting setup or questions already answered.

say_en.text: Draft a sponsor update for me
say_en.note: Separates promised outcomes, measured results, acceptance

say_en.text: Use @fde's current scope for this readout
say_en.note: Reuses the sanitized packet, no restart

say_en.text: Mark any checks that were not run
say_en.note: Missing capability or unrun checks are stated plainly
